audit.whatIsWrong: The chart (Mundo, Skill, Singed, Singed, Mundo, Singed, Singed) contradicts its own whys[] on five of seven rows: whys[0] says level 1 is even, whys[2] says level 3 favours you, whys[3] says 4-5 stay yours, whys[5] says first item favours you, whys[6] calls 2+ items a coin-flip. spikes[0], spikes[2], spikes[3] and mid all agree with the whys, not the chart.
audit.why: The packet chart is [Skill, Skill, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Skill, Dr. Mundo, Skill], which matches the prose exactly. But the mirror audit on Singed's side explicitly examined this and concluded the packet snapshot is stale and the on-disk chart is right, and the on-disk Singed chart mirrors this one. I have two internally consistent stories and no way to break the tie from the kits, and 49.91% does not favour either. I am not flipping the chart on a coin toss — see questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating and carryRating are empty strings, and the level-6 spike never mentions the one thing that changes at 6 for Singed.
audit.why: breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t already state 'difficulty 6/10, Singed carry threat 6/10'. And Insanity Potion (100s, 100 mana) is the level-6 spike that matters: Riot's text says it makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which is the direct counter to both of Mundo's heals.
audit.corrected: diffRating 6/10, carryRating 6/10; phases[4].why and spikes[1].text now carry the anti-heal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was treated as an unavoidable flip on a 14s cooldown, and Mundo's passive never appears in relation to it.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, not 14s, and its cast range is 125 — Singed has to be standing on you. It is a displacement, which is exactly the class of effect Goes Where He Pleases resists: the first one is eaten and drops a cannister that heals Mundo and shortens the passive's own cooldown when he walks over it. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion from Singed's side and stated it there, so both pages now say the same thing. The real spell to respect is Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1, 1000 range) — it grounds and slows, and a Fling that lands a target inside it roots them.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, phases[2].why and tradeGood now carry the real Fling cooldown and range, the passive interaction, and Mega Adhesive as the actual threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flagged zero sequencing advice, and the one cooldown given was wrong.
audit.why: Fling 10s at rank 1, Mega Adhesive 17s at rank 1, Insanity Potion 100s, Maximum Dosage 120s. The 100 versus 120 gap is the sequencing rule that matters: his anti-heal ult comes back 20 seconds sooner than your heal.
audit.corrected: All four numbers now appear, with 'press R before he presses his'.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood, breakdown.trading and report[3].t all end with '• • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 70' — a page-footer artifact from whatever PDF this text was extracted from.
audit.why: It is not advice and it is visible on the live page.
audit.corrected: tradeGood rewritten without it. breakdown.trading and report[3].t still contain it — they are derived strings and need a scripted pass, not a hand edit.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Fling is up.
edits.after: Fling is only 125 range and your passive eats the first one — the thing to dodge is Mega Adhesive, which grounds and slows on a 17s cooldown.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Singed to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage (120s) heals off missing health, but Insanity Potion (100s) makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — spend yours before his lands.

edits.before: - Singed Fling (14s): matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then commit. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Singed Fling (10s at rank 1, 125 range): matchup-defining — your passive eats the first one, then walk over the cannister. - Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1) grounds and slows. - Insanity Potion (100s) puts Grievous Wounds on his trail — press R before he does.

edits.before: Track Singed’s Fling (14s): His flip. Bait it, then commit. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Fling (10s at rank 1, 125 range): your passive eats the first one and drops a cannister — walk over it, then go.

edits.before: Line up your trajectory cleanly past enemy minion models. Launch an Infected Bonesaw (Q) to slow and chunk their current health, then step forward only when they are slowed to execute a quick auto-attack into an enhanced Blunt Force (E) reset. If they retaliate with heavy crowd control, your passive will pop a canister backward—walk over it immediately to heal up and walk away clean. • • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 70
edits.after: Fling is 125 range — he has to be on top of you to use it, and your passive eats the first one anyway, so the flip you fear costs him 60 mana and gets him nothing. Infected Bonesaw (Q) reaches 975 and slows: throw it as he drafts past, then step in on an auto into the E reset. Never chase down a Poison Trail; he pays 13 mana a tick to make you walk it, and Insanity Potion turns that trail into Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage lets you chase through his Fling and Poison Trail; he can flip you toward his tower but you simply heal it back and keep marching, so your R denies the kingpin flip payoff that Singed lives on.
edits.after: Both ults land at 6. Your passive eats the first Fling outright, and Maximum Dosage heals back what the flip costs — but Insanity Potion (100s) puts Grievous Wounds on his trail, so press R before he presses his.

edits.before: Use R Maximum Dosage to out-sustain his Poison Trail in extended fights
edits.after: Press R before Insanity Potion lands — its Grievous Wounds halves it

notes:
Chart left untouched deliberately. It contradicts its own whys[] on five rows and contradicts the packet chart, but it agrees with the already-audited Singed side, and the mirror auditor examined exactly this and declared the packet snapshot stale for this matchup. Flipping it would either be wrong or would be immediately reverted by mirror-fix.js. Question recorded instead.

Fling's cooldown was listed as 14s in two places; it is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. Its cast range is 125, which is worth more to the reader than the cooldown.

The supplied missingInteraction (Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halving Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage) is correct and is now in phases[4].why, spikes[1].text, wants.you[2] and breakdown.cooldowns with the timing rule: your R is 120s, his is 100s, so his comes back first and you cannot afford to trade ults on his schedule.

PDF footer artifact '• • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 70' is present in tradeGood (removed here), breakdown.trading and report[3].t (both left — derived strings).
